category_description: Saving, investing and protecting your money in the United States.
label: HSA contribution limit, self-only coverage
context: The annual limit on deductions for an individual with self-only coverage under a high deductible health plan.

label: HSA contribution limit, family coverage
context: The annual limit on deductions for an individual with family coverage under a high deductible health plan.

label: Minimum deductible for a high deductible health plan, self-only
context: A plan must have an annual deductible of at least this much for self-only coverage.

label: Minimum deductible for a high deductible health plan, family
context: A plan must have an annual deductible of at least this much for family coverage.

label: Out-of-pocket limit for a high deductible health plan, self-only
context: Annual out-of-pocket expenses, meaning deductibles, copayments and other amounts but not premiums, cannot exceed this for self-only coverage.

label: Out-of-pocket limit for a high deductible health plan, family
context: Annual out-of-pocket expenses, meaning deductibles, copayments and other amounts but not premiums, cannot exceed this for family coverage.

subject_intro: How health savings accounts work, the annual contribution limits for self-only and family coverage, and what makes a health plan a high deductible plan.
subject_meta_description: HSA contribution limits for {tax_year} are {fact:us_hsa_self} for self-only coverage and {fact:us_hsa_family} for family coverage. See the HDHP deductible and out-of-pocket rules.
